annotations.title: Tesla Superchargers coming soon and newly opened

description: Tesla Superchargers that are planned, permit filed, under construction or newly opened in the U.S.: "Tesla Superchargers coming soon near Austin", "Superchargers under construction in Ohio", "new Tesla Superchargers this month", "third-party Superchargers". Site data from supercharge.info, read twice a day. Send place (or lat and lng) for the nearest sites, nearest first; state for one state's sites; stage to choose pipeline (the default: planned, permit filed and under construction), planned, permit, construction, opened (opened in the last 30 days), vote (sites in Tesla's location vote) or any. Filter by third_party (sites a third party owns), open_to_other_evs and nevi_funded. Each site comes with its status and the day it started, its source link, stalls, power, plugs, whether other EVs can charge, host, address or town, third-party owner, NEVI match, its ChargingNear.me page (url) and, once open, its station page (station_url). No pipeline site has a published opening date.

lat.description: Latitude (with lng), if you have coordinates instead of a place

nevi_funded.description: true: only sites our NEVI data matches by location (150 m)

open_to_other_evs.description: true: only sites supercharge.info lists as open to other EVs

place.description: A U.S. city, address or ZIP code, e.g. "Austin, TX", for the nearest sites. Use instead of lat and lng.

radius.description: With place or lat and lng: only sites within this many miles (max 3000; by default the nearest at any distance)

stage.description: pipeline (planned, permit filed and under construction; the default); planned; permit; construction; opened (opened in the last 30 days); vote (in Tesla's location vote); any

state.description: Only one state's sites: a two-letter code (OH) or name (Ohio)

third_party.description: true: only sites a third party owns (not Tesla); false: only Tesla's own
